clips.text: Welcome it in its endless forms with an attitude of complete acceptance.
And do not impose yourself on life; life has its own discipline, its own wisdom, and those who are ready to live totally have no need for any other discipline or wisdom.
But you have always been afraid of life and therefore you are afraid of love.
Now life has begun penetrating you, breaking your walls of security.
So, God's infinite grace showers on you!
Don't run from it now, accept it gratefully and my good wishes are always with you.
